title: Missing attestation identity verification or policy binding
description: Quote verification code should not trust qe_identity, tcb_info, or related collateral unless certificate chain validation, signature validation, and identity-policy binding all hold on the path that reaches the trust decision.

recommended_checks.why: A production verifier should reject debug-mode QE or enclave reports when the trust model requires production mode.
Certificate-chain validation should also reject CA certificates used as end-entity signing certificates.
TCB component arrays should be compared element-by-element instead of with lexicographic string ordering.
Rust, JS, Go, Python, and FFI bindings should enforce the same attestation obligations.

confidence_strategy.high: A trust-bearing result is reachable and one required obligation is absent on the same path.
confidence_strategy.medium: Relevant helpers exist, but identity fields are consumed in a way that suggests incomplete binding.
confidence_strategy.needs_review: Checks are split across helpers, files, or language boundaries and the static proof is incomplete.

llm_review_questions: Is untrusted identity material parsed before it is authenticated?
Does the trust decision depend on identity fields without proof of signature validation?
Are mrsigner, isvprodid, isvsvn, miscselect, and attributes all enforced?
Is one backend or binding weaker than another?
